blocks.text: 1928 mein Paul Dirac ne prediction (peshgoi) ki ke har fundamental particle ka ek anti-particle (ulta particle) hota hai. Anti-particle ka rest mass (ruki hui halat ka mass) apne particle jitna hota hai magar charge ulta. Maslan positron electron ka anti-particle hai; is ka symbol e⁺ hai. Positron ka rest mass electron jitna hai magar us par utne hi magnitude ka positive charge hai. Positron sab se pehle discover hone wala anti-particle tha: Anderson ne isay 1932 mein cloud chamber ke experiment mein dekha. Yeh kisi anti-particle ki pehli experimental discovery thi; is ke baad bohat se anti-particles mile. Aam taur par anti-particle ko letter ke oopar bar (lakeer) laga kar likhte hain, maslan anti-proton p̄ aur antineutrino ν̄.

blocks.title: For Your Information
blocks.text:
1. Particle accelerator ek bari machine hai jo electrons, protons ya ions jaise charged particles ko bohat zyada energy aur roshni ki speed ke qareeb speeds tak tez (accelerate) karti hai.
2. Linear accelerators, cyclotrons aur betatrons important particle accelerators hain.

blocks.title: Interesting Information
blocks.text: Is discovery par Dirac aur Anderson ko Physics ka Nobel Prize mila: Dirac ko 1933 mein aur Anderson ko 1936 mein. 1955 mein Segre aur Chamberlain ne particle accelerator se antiproton discover kiya aur 1959 mein unhein is par Physics ka Nobel Prize mila.

Ab tak discover hone wale bohat se particles mein se quarks aur leptons ko fundamental (bunyadi) particles, yani elementary particles, mana gaya hai. In elementary particles ke bhi anti-particles hain.

blocks.title: Do you know?
blocks.text:
(i) Cosmic rays outer space (khala) se aane wale bohat zyada energy ke particles hain; in ka source pakka maloom nahi, shayad Suraj ya doosre sitare. Yeh zyada tar protons, neutrons aur bhaari nuclei hain jo Zameen par lagatar barste rehte hain. Atmosphere (hawa ki tah) ki gases ke atoms se takra kar yeh secondary particles ki showers (barish) banate hain jo hum par har waqt barasti hai.
(ii) Jab uranium-235 jaise unstable radioactive element ke nuclei nuclear reactor mein fission (toot kar do hisse hona) karte hain to neutrons, neutrinos, α-particles, photons, electrons aur positrons jaise kai particles nikalte hain.
(iii) Jab electrons aur protons jaise charged particles ko accelerator se tez kar ke hydrogen ke target par mara jaye, to yeh aapas mein aamne saamne bhi takra sakte hain; in takkaron ke malbe (debris) mein pions, kaons, muons aur antiprotons tak milte hain.
